summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packet acceptance (accept_source_route) on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf covering all/default/eth0/lo scopes, applied live with sysctl --system, and verified persistence across a full node reboot (boot_id changed from 717db5a2... to e9552362...).
actions_performed: Checked baseline sysctl values for accept_redirects/secure_redirects/accept_source_route on node1
Applied config live with sysctl --system and verified runtime values became 0 across all scopes including per-interface eth0
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 via background nohup so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was reachable again, confirming new boot_id (e9552362-9785-4beb-b609-00e9965f8377)
Re-verified all hardened sysctl values remained 0 post-reboot and confirmed the config file persisted on disk

evidence.summary: Showed accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and secure_redirects=1 (all/default) before the fix; accept_source_route was already 0.
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf and applied via sysctl --system; output shows all/default/eth0/lo accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route all set to 0.

evidence.requirement: Runtime effective values confirmed 0 including per-interface eth0
evidence.summary: Initial check found eth0 still inheriting accept_redirects=1/secure_redirects=1 despite all/default=0; corrected by adding explicit eth0/lo entries, then reapplied and confirmed all values 0.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + hardening state)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01 and confirmed all hardening sysctls at 0 immediately before reboot.
systemctl reboot scheduled via backgrounded nohup command; tool call returned 'reboot_scheduled' before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Proof of actual restart (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Connection reset confirmed the reboot took effect; subsequent poll returned new boot_id e9552362-9785-4beb-b609-00e9965f8377, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real restart occurred.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of hardening
evidence.summary: After reboot, uptime showed a fresh boot time and all net.ipv4.conf.{all,default,eth0,lo}.{accept_redirects,secure_redirects,accept_source_route} sysctls remained 0; sysctl.d config file confirmed intact on disk.
